description.en: Filters the results by a list of feature entity IDs.
The ID of the instance. To obtain the ID, call the `ListInstances` API operation.
Filters the results by feature entity name.

description.zh:
排序方式，可选值包括：

- Asc - 升序排序。

- Desc - 降序排序。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `Asc`: Ascending order.

- `Desc`: Descending order.
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the creator.

description.zh: 页码，起始值为1，默认值为1。
description.en: The page number. Values start at 1. Default value: 1.
The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
父特征实体ID过滤。
不传，列出所有的特征实体。
传0，列出所有根特征实体。
传非0数值，列出指定父特征实体下所有子特征实体。
description.en: Filters the results by parent feature entity ID. Omit this parameter to return all feature entities. Set it to `0` to return all root feature entities. Set it to a non-zero value to return all child feature entities of the specified parent.
The project ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the `ListProjects` operation.
The field to sort the results by.
